summary.tldr: Repeals two rules that can cause permanent residents to lose status or become inadmissible when refugee protection ends.
what_it_does: Repeals section 40.1 of the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act, which deals with inadmissibility linked to cessation of refugee protection.
Repeals paragraph 46(1)(c.1) of that Act, which deals with loss of status linked to cessation of refugee protection.
summary.background: The bill amends the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act. Its drafters say it would repeal rules tied to inadmissibility and loss of status when refugee protection ends for permanent residents.
